lifetime.scope: Recorded native ACK precedes source retirement. Both coordinator credits retire and final native KV allocations are empty. This is not GPU DMA timing or HF fidelity.

frozen_SLO.rule: 2x independent serial-calibration p95 request latency; 2x token ITL p99.

metrics.scope: Instrumented calibration only. Serial or bounded burst, not clean open-loop serving or capacity.
metrics.latency_share_scope: Disjoint host request intervals. Denominator is summed request E2E latency, not wall time, GPU time, or a sum of component percentiles.

metrics.arrival_rate_scope: The retained realized_arrival_QPS field measures the finite scheduled trace. actual_submit_QPS measures actual coordinator send starts. Neither is completed throughput.

metrics.service_start_limit: Not a CUPTI first-kernel timestamp. Clock uncertainty is retained per request.
metrics.timing_scope: Device enclosures include launch gaps and possibly other requests. They are not exclusive GPU kernel times.
metrics.service_scope: Native model-stream entry event to first output, including handoff and continuation.

actual_work.scope: Actual P-to-D serving continuation. No independent D-local probes. Rows are not FLOPs. Transfer bytes are payload counters, not control-message or wire-header bytes.
